sources.title: DOCCI: Descriptions of Connected and Contrasting Images
sources.authority_reason: Original dataset authors' research paper defines description content, contrastive collection and human image-to-text evaluation.
sources.inspection_note: Read Fig.1 p.2, Fig.2 p.3, §2.1 Contrastive Images p.5, §2.2 pp.5–6 and §4 p.9. Distinguishes object properties, action/pose and spatial relations; main versus secondary detail; precision errors are hallucinations, recall errors missing information. Contrastive examples have same subjects with different poses/actions. These support evaluation principles, not this course model performance.

sources.title: VQA: Visual Question Answering
sources.authority_reason: Original VQA task and evaluation authors establish question-conditioned visual answering.
sources.inspection_note: Read §1 p.1 and §3 pp.3–4: question-specific detection/counting/activity capabilities; concise 1–3 word answers often suffice; multiple correct answers are possible. The paper's automatic metric uses normalized exact match and does not establish the course's semantic paraphrase metric.

sources.title: Making the V in VQA Matter: Elevating the Role of Image Understanding in Visual Question Answering
sources.authority_reason: Original VQA-v2 complementary-image protocol directly addresses image-sensitive evaluation.
sources.inspection_note: Read §1 pp.1–2 and §3 p.3: complementary real images share question Q and have different correct A/A′; this tests visual dependence and reduces language priors. Does not make an arbitrary pixel change imply a correct answer change or establish broad ability from a few pairs.
